## Outcome

A reusable test kit and contribution template for checking relationships in exported telemetry.

Task 4 of the nine-task Agent Behavior Trace Model execution plan following the August WG discussions.

**Why:** A trace that looks right in one demonstration may still produce incorrect results after records are lost, repeated, or reordered.

**Work:** Create language-neutral sample records, expected answers, and reusable checks. Reuse OTel conformance tooling, adding relationship tests and a template for source mappings and limitations. Use synthetic data, opt-in content capture, and separately labeled deterministic and live integration tests.

**Example:** Deliver the same ticket-creation receipt twice: the expected result is still one confirmed ticket. Remove the receipt: the expected result becomes “creation unconfirmed,” not “no ticket was created.”

## Acceptance Criteria

**Done when:** contributors can run these checks and add a focused example without adopting a new runtime or implementing the whole workflow.

## Tracking

- **Workstream:** Agent Behavior Trace Model
- **Owner:** needs owner
- **Status:** needs owner
- **Next step:** Find a contributor and reviewer, then turn the first contract examples into fixtures and expected answers.
- **Depends on:** [Task 3](https://github.com/aaif/wg-observability-and-traceability/issues/41); develop alongside [Task 5](https://github.com/aaif/wg-observability-and-traceability/issues/43) and [Task 6](https://github.com/aaif/wg-observability-and-traceability/issues/44).
